tickets.title: Search index lag after a malformed document
tickets.description: The search-indexer fell behind by several hours after one malformed document blocked a batch.

comments.author: ines
comments.text: The indexer now quarantines a document that fails parsing twice and continues with the batch. Alert fires when index lag exceeds 20 minutes.

tickets.title: Warehouse load missed its window
tickets.description: The nightly load finished late because an upstream export arrived after midnight.

comments.author: tomas
comments.text: Load now waits for the export manifest instead of a fixed start time.
